descriptionChirho: To return or restore a physical object to its place (active transitive, concrete spatial sense)

labelChirho: to turn away from, reject, desert
descriptionChirho: To turn oneself away from a person, authority, or truth; to abandon, reject, or refuse (middle/passive and intransitive uses involving personal or doctrinal abandonment)
To cause ungodliness or wickedness to be removed; to turn someone away from sin (active transitive with God as agent and sin as the thing removed)
To turn people away from right allegiance; to mislead or subvert (causative active, with a person or group as object being led astray)
